format: list of MCQ records like datasets/data/medxpertqa_text.json + image_paths (absolute)
split_rule: per dataset: exact dedup on (normalised query incl. options, sorted image sha1s); image groups = connected components of questions sharing any image (content sha1); group keys sorted then random.Random(0).shuffle; walk groups in that order, a group goes to eval if it fits within the target (eval = 200, or half the kept items if < 400), otherwise to corpus; files keep this seeded order (within a group: source order). No image is shared between eval and corpus.

medxpertqa_mm.license_note: MIT (dataset card). Images originate from third-party medical sources per the paper.
medxpertqa_mm.filters: config MM, test split; 5-option MCQ, options as given ('Answer Choices:' block stripped from the stem and re-rendered as 'Options:'); all images attached; dropped: items whose option text contains a non-table line break (leaked distractor-generation rationale). Flags: options_are_image_labels (option texts are letters drawn in the image), options_markdown_table

pathvqa.license_note: MIT (dataset card); card notes image/caption copyrights belong to the textbook publishers and PEIR.
pathvqa.filters: test split; answer in {yes, no} only; options fixed A. yes / B. no

slake.filters: test.json; q_lang == en; answer_type == CLOSED; yes/no -> A. yes / B. no; other closed answers kept only if the question names >= 2 alternatives ('..., X or Y' / '..., X, Y or Z' after the first comma, or single-word 'X or Y' at the end) and the answer equals exactly one of them (options in question order)

answer_not_among_alternatives_examples.question: Which is bigger in this image, kidney or spleen?

kvasir_vqa_x1.license_note: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (dataset card): academic / non-commercial use only.
kvasir_vqa_x1.filters: test split; complexity == 1 (single atomic QA); atomic answer in {yes, no} (gold label); x1 rephrased question used as the stem only if it starts with an auxiliary verb, contains no 'remain|residual' (polarity inversion vs atomic 'Have all polyps been removed?'), and matches a per-class keyword (box artifact: 'green or black'; text: 'text'; finding: 'abnormal|finding'; polyp removal: 'all|complete'); options A. yes / B. no
